Allowance.description: cutting_fold also requires a licensed on_fold piece whose fold axis and this named CUT edge cover the same saved boundary extent.

Claim.description: physical_fit is always unresolved in this comparator; caller status/class and physical-test references are retained only as unverified evidence.

Closure.description: Every instance closure role must be explicitly covered as a primary or companion role on an allowed side; the primary role cannot be its own companion.

sample_fractions.description: Additional probes: strictly increasing, exact 0 and 1 endpoints, checked by the comparator. Comparator-owned probes always include the normalized saved vertices of both curves.

Notch.description: Only physical stations or duplicate glyphs reconciled to exactly one physical mark with the same owner edge, instance, logical ID, role, side and projected station can satisfy a sewn pairing.

Polyline.description: Saved points; the point cap is a resource control, not a drafting constant.

description: The packaged comparator checks this schema and cross-record invariants. No raw CAD role inference or physical fit certification. All geometry must use the single declared coordinate unit. Size and work limits are source-independent resource controls, not drafting or garment acceptance constants; runtime checks also enforce cross-record invariants and finite derived arithmetic.
title: Explicit saved-polyline semantic comparison manifest
